title: Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Ash is a scale-up building logistics apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is fully remote within the country.

Our stack: kotlin. You will ship features end to end, work closely with design and product and review code with the team.

Four-day weeks in summer. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.

The role includes a 24/7 on-call rotation.
